title: Family-Adjustment Relief First Counted Day, TRICARE Reserve Select
content:
**Desk guidance - TRICARE Premium-Based Plans, TRICARE Reserve Select.**

Whether the day the family-adjustment relief is counted from is itself counted follows the application for that active duty enrollment: where the family-adjustment relief is counted from the enrollment's effective date or from the first day the adjustment covers and the enrollment was applied for on or before that day, that day is the first day counted; where it is counted from either of those days and the enrollment was applied for after that day, the first day counted is the day after the application date; otherwise the first day counted is the day after the day the family-adjustment relief is counted from.

The application date is the date the purchaser's TRICARE Prime Active Duty Service Member enrollment was applied for, as its record shows.

| Counted from | Applied for | First day counted |
|---|---|---|
| 24 June, the effective date | 20 June | 24 June |
| 24 June, the effective date | 26 June | 27 June |
| 20 June, the first day the adjustment covers | 18 June | 20 June |
| 20 June, the first day the adjustment covers | 21 June | 22 June |
| the plan's termination date, 25 June | any date | 26 June |
